subject: Re: AtlasBio — request for extended POC credits and term variance
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@atlasbio.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@atlasbio.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jan 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot extension & credits — AtlasBio regulatory eval

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo — team was impressed with the latency and the traceability features. We need to run a parallel regulatory validation for our clinical ingestion pipeline which will take longer than the standard 30-day PLG sandbox. Given the scope (PII-handling and audit log requirements) our security team also needs a populated questionnaire and a slightly larger allowance for tokens to run internal stress tests.

As a small company with a tight budget, we were hoping Redwood could authorize a one-time pilot uplift: an additional 60k tokens of free credits and a 45-day extension to the sandbox window. This will let us finish the regulatory checks and build a robust mutual action plan for a dedicated deployment.

Attached is our latest SOW draft and the security questionnaire your team requested. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Sara
Sara Nguyen
Head of ML Engineering, AtlasBio
Attachments: AtlasBio_SOW_draft.pdf (application/pdf), AtlasBio_security_questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jan 2026 12:01:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pilot extension & credits — AtlasBio regulatory eval

Marissa / Aditya — forwarding Sara's ask. AtlasBio is a strategic mid-market prospect (bioinformatics, potential Dedicated deal next quarter). They need additional credits (60k tokens) and +45 days on the sandbox to complete regulatory signoffs. They also attached a SOW and security questionnaire — Grace, can you confirm if their answers meet our baseline?

Questions for Deal Desk:
- Can we approve 60k in free credits as a one-off (nonstandard) tied to a signed MSA within 90 days?
- Can we extend the sandbox from 30 -> 75 days for this account?
- If credits are not fully approvable, what's the alternative (discount vs. staged top-up vs. funded POC)?

I recommend we consider a partial uplift + a documented mutual action plan. If we commit Dedicated next quarter, we should be flexible.

Thanks,
Vivek
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot extension & credits — AtlasBio regulatory eval

Vivek / Aditya — quick read and recommendation:

- 60k tokens (one-time) seems reasonable for a validated regulatory POC if tied to explicit acceptance criteria and an MSA signature timeline (we should make credit release contingent on a signed PO/MSA within 90 days).
- 45 extra days (total 75) is longer than standard but acceptable for regulated evaluations. We should avoid open-ended windows.
- Alternative: offer a staged uplift: 30k immediate + 30k on completion of checklist (security questionnaire + one compliance audit). That reduces risk and gives AtlasBio runway.

If Aditya signs off on the one-time credit cap and the 75-day sandbox, I'll prepare a short addendum and a HubSpot task for CS to track the acceptance criteria. Also suggest Loop in Legal for streamlined SOW -> MSA flow; we should avoid manual redlines.

-Marissa
Sr. AE, Strategic Accounts

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot extension & credits — AtlasBio regulatory eval

Folks — approved with conditions below.

Approval summary:
- One-time free credits: 60,000 tokens approved.
- Sandbox extension: 75 days total (45 extra) approved.
- Conditions: credits released in two tranches (30k now, 30k after completion of security checklist and short compliance ping). Credits expire 120 days after final tranche.
- Business conditions: Addendum must reference target MSA signature within 90 days; if not signed, remaining credits are revoked.

Grace — please validate the security questionnaire. Marissa — prepare the addendum language and HubSpot task. Vivek — I'll send a short authorization note to Legal to prioritize AtlasBio's SOW review.

Thanks,
Aditya
Head of Revenue Operations

From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@atlasbio.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@atlasbio.com>, Legal <legal@atlasbio.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AtlasBio — pilot uplift confirmation

Vivek — amazing, thank you and please pass along our thanks to Aditya and Marissa. The staged approach works well for our timeline. A couple quick notes:

- We'll sign the addendum and return the PO within 30 days; procurement expects to route the MSA immediately after.
- We completed the security questionnaire and addressed a few follow-ups in cell B12 — hopefully that's sufficient for the first tranche. If any gaps remain we'll resolve them quickly.

I've attached the SOW and marked the sections Legal will focus on. Next step for Redwood: send the addendum + HubSpot task and confirm token tranche release mechanics.

Best,
Sara
Head of ML Engineering, AtlasBio
Attachments: AtlasBio_SOW_draft.pdf, AtlasBio_security_questionnaire.xlsx
